milestones.description: Uses inventory_has because when a trapped chest is mined, it drops as an item ('trapped_chest') that enters the player's inventory. This is the most reliable way to confirm the block was actually broken and collected, and inventory_has is the preferred rule for mine tasks.

Uses position_near_with_facing because 'interact with hopper' requires the player to walk up to the hopper and face it (to right-click it). The evaluator cannot directly detect GUI-open events, so we verify the player has navigated to within close range of the hopper and is facing it — which is the necessary precondition for interaction. The hopper is at spawn-relative (3, 0, -3). max_distance=3 ensures the player is within right-click range, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking at the hopper.
